coverage_rules: New r2/r3 observer source/schema changes require exact reviewed diff and mapping update, never automatic old-field inheritance.
Physical interval comes from actual source epoch begin/end, with documented half-open normalization; do not guess 0 or invent requester kernel.
PHASE buckets are disjoint active-state observation buckets, not requester/victim kernel ownership.
Production probe not reached is separate from reached but relief not consulted. Keep both bins; do not add to the narrower alias or infer eligible intersection without recorded joint support.
Primary bins are exclusive precedence reasons; masks and predicate bits may overlap and are not a time or speedup decomposition.
samples are bounded examples, never denominators; no event matching claimed from aggregate head vs commit counts.
Measured old RO accepted counts, transactions, merges, responses retain separate units.
A CURRENT_ACCEPTED_DIAGNOSTIC_POINT requires real complete application/native exit0/full input/64slice/drain plus exact new source/schema qualification, never this preparation.
pending_source_feedback: E2-00000073-8690b82e0a94 merge denial reason and actual M1 capacity consulted coverage
phase_reconciliation: Each native field sums over source PHASE buckets to slice, then exact64slice to GLOBAL; shared physical interval not causal per-kernel decomposition.
raw_pressure_shares: Only pressure_no_live_ro, pressure_live_ro_no_eligible and pressure_eligible form the raw pressure partition when T=true; undefined percentage at denominator0, never fill0.
old_history: Old SGEMM empty-certificate/FWT same-line-store exclusion explanations remain separate; no retroactive dynamic attribution.
